axĭtĭōsus , a, um, adj. id.,
I.acting together, in combination; of a party: Axitiosae annonam caram e vili concinnant viris, Plaut. ap. Varr. L. L. 7, § 66 Müll.: “Mulier es, uxor—Cuja vis?—Ego novi: scio axitiosam,” id. ib.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
